name: Mage hunters
description: Mage hunters are insect-like, armored creatures with glowing spines from Galathul that sense magic and were used by the Oriq against Strixhaven.

description_citations.text: "Oriq attack on Strixhaven". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

summary.text: Mage hunters are insect-like, armored creatures with glowing spines from Galathul that sense magic and were used by the Oriq against Strixhaven.

citations.text: "Oriq attack on Strixhaven". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: At Strixhaven the Dragonsguard killed one by dragging it into the earth, and later a swarm approached the school under Lukka's control.

citations.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.
"Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

bio.text: Oriq forces led by Extus Narr attacked Strixhaven with them, and students and staff fought them across campus.

citations.text: "Oriq attack on Strixhaven", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

bio.text: The dragons burned many to ash, and Lukka severed his link to them, after which the freed creatures turned on the nearest Oriq agents.

citations.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.
"Episode 5: Final Exam" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Apr 2021.
"Episode 5: Final Exam" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Apr 2021.

bio.text: Further mage hunters later attacked at Bow's End, where students led by Dina blasted them to pieces.

citations.text: "A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.
"A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.

bio.text: In Reality Fracture they circle the Theorist's tower in search of magic and swarm the wasteland called the Eradia.

citations.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2026.

citations.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 8: Keep Your Lids Open" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2026.

status.text: As of Reality Fracture, mage hunters still prowl the Eradia and circle the tower's base.

citations.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 8: Keep Your Lids Open
citations.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 8: Keep Your Lids Open" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2026.

citations.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 6: The Man Who Kills His Own Ambition" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: The Dragonsguard drags a mage hunter into the earth with roots.
timeline.quote: roots as thick as his arm burst forth from the ground, wrapping around the chitinous legs of the creature

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: A swarm of mage hunters approaches the school, and Lukka says they are just getting started.
timeline.quote: a swarm of chitinous, chittering forms scurried between the trees

citation.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Kasmina flees in a cloud of white feathers.
timeline.quote: a cloud of white feathers whipped over her, and she was gone

citation.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Wickel raises a wall of earth to hold back mage hunters while students flee.
timeline.quote: A semicircle of churning soil rippled out from where he stood, rising up into a wall of dense earth between the creatures and the students.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Rowan, Plink and Auvernine fight mage hunters at the Witherbloom dormitories.
timeline.quote: Rowan howled and swung her sword.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Dean Kianne spears a mage hunter with a lance of force.
timeline.quote: Kianne sent a geometric lance of force piercing through it.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Liliana spots a man in a red uniform with mandible-like features who commands the mage hunters.
timeline.quote: He locked eyes with her, and with eerie coordination, all of the other mage hunters surged toward them.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Will freezes dew to trip a mage hunter and drains heat from another's shell.
timeline.quote: Behind him, the evening dew condensed into hard ice.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: The dragons arrive and burn the mage hunters to ash with columns of fire.
timeline.quote: A column of fire shot down from the sky and swept over the ground.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Onyx tells them the mage hunters have formed a perimeter around the Biblioplex.
timeline.quote: They've formed a perimeter around the Biblioplex.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Across campus, Lukka feels the roar while controlling the mage hunters and tells Mila that Extus got what he wanted.
timeline.quote: It found Lukka, even through the concentration it took from him to keep all the mage hunters fighting on several fronts.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Final Exam" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Dragonfire kills nearby mage hunters, and Lukka severs the link to avoid being overwhelmed.
timeline.quote: he severed the link before he could be overwhelmed

citation.text: "Episode 5: Final Exam" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Freed mage hunters turn on the nearest Oriq agents.
timeline.quote: turned on the nearest source of magical sustenance: Oriq agents

citation.text: "Episode 5: Final Exam" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Extus stands before his alma mater and commands the mage hunters to unfold.
timeline.quote: At his command, the mage hunters unfolded.

citation.text: Mage Hunters' Onslaught (Strixhaven: School of Mages, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Mage hunters push in and professors scramble, leaving Strixhaven's heart undefended.
timeline.quote: Professors scrambled to push the mage hunters back, leaving the heart of Strixhaven undefended.

citation.text: Defend the Campus (Strixhaven: School of Mages, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Fannessa reveals that mage hunters attack outside.
timeline.quote: Our mage hunters will wipe them all out

citation.text: "A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: A mage hunter bursts in and carries Fannessa away.
timeline.quote: several chittering legs collected her

citation.text: "A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Killian's signed light blinds and immobilizes the mage hunters.
timeline.quote: Killian's spells flowed like water down their backs and along their tails, where it consumed their termini, immobilizing them.

citation.text: "A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Students led by Dina blast the mage hunters to pieces.
timeline.quote: The final attack came from Dina, who hurled an enormous ball of pulsing beryl magic at the horrid creatures and shattered them into pieces.

citation.text: "A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: His magic leaves a wasteland, the Eradia, around the tower.
timeline.quote: the Theorist's reality-bending magic left a wasteland surrounding it for nearly a hundred miles

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2026.

timeline.summary: Uldaros Theorix builds Hexhaven's original fortress to keep the campus from mage hunters.
timeline.quote: The elder sphinx Uldaros Theorix used his reality-bending magic to build the original fortress of Hexhaven

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2026.

timeline.summary: The Theorist prepares to kill the oracle on the tower balcony as mage hunters circle below.
timeline.quote: He stands on the balcony of the tower.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 8: Keep Your Lids Open
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 8: Keep Your Lids Open" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Lukka helps the Oriq by distracting Kasmina and coordinating a Mage Hunter attack on Strixhaven.
timeline.quote: Lukka helped the Oriq by distracting Kasmina

citation.text: "Oriq", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oriq forces led by Extus Narr attacked Strixhaven with Mage Hunters.
timeline.quote: the Strixhaven campus in Arcavios was subjected to a large-scale assault by Oriq forces led by Extus Narr

citation.text: "Oriq attack on Strixhaven", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.note: Created as one of the Oriq's tools.
relations.quote: One of the Oriq's most powerful tools is the mage hunter, a vile monstrosity created to seek out and snuff out the arcane.

citation.text: Mage Hunter (Strixhaven: School of Mages, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

relations.note: Mage hunters are created by the Oriq.

citation.text: Mage Hunter (Strixhaven: School of Mages, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

relations.note: Mage hunters attack Hexhaven and its mages.
relations.quote: keeping the campus out of reach of the mage hunters, which had grown bolder in their attacks.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2026.
